newsitem.title: FRANCE: U.N. agency urges Israel to close tunnel.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency urges Israel to close tunnel.

text.p: The United Nations cultural agency accused Israel on Thursday of violating international principles by opening a tunnel under Arab East Jerusalem and urged it rescind its decision and close the tunnel.
The U.N. Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation blamed the Jewish state for igniting an explosion of violence in the West Bank and Gaza Strip and called for the resumption of peace talks.

"This dangerous spiral of events is the result of the decision taken by the Israeli authorities to open a tunnel for tourists in the immediate vicinity of the al-Aqsa Mosque," UNESCO director-general Federico Mayor said in a statement.

"It contravenes the 1956 New Delhi recommendation which forgids excavations in occupied territory, signed at the time by the State of Israel," he said. "I call upon the government of Israel to rescind its decision and close the tunnel."
At least 50 people have been killed in two days in the worst violence since the 1993 Israel-PLO peace accords led to limited Palestinian self-rule in parts of the West Bank and Gaza.
